subject: Decision timetable & compliance mandates — next steps
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Bob Chen <bob.chen@midline.ai>, Martha Li <martha.li@midline.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Decision timetable & compliance mandates — next steps

Hi Bob / Martha —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on the buying process and who owns which gate.

Key takeaways from the call:
- Primary outcome: Midline is evaluating Redwood for inference at scale (model-hosting + dedicated pools) with an initial POC targeting low-latency recommendations.
- Economic owner: Martha Li (CFO) will sign off on budget allocation for Q4.
- Security checklist items: SSO (SAML + SCIM), data retention controls, SOC2 evidence, and optional on-prem packaging for sensitive workloads.
- Procurement: Midline procurement wants standard SOW plus a procurement worksheet and vendor questionnaire returned by their team.

Proposed mutual-action plan (high level):
1) Week 1 (Jun 22–28): Redwood to share a draft MAP and security questionnaire; Midline to confirm econ approver and list legal/procurement contacts.
2) Week 2 (Jun 29–Jul 6): Redwood delivers price band for Dedicated slots and draft SOW; Midline legal flags any major redlines.
3) Week 3 (Jul 7–Jul 14): POC kickoff (technical), security review completion; procurement prepares PO template.
4) Week 4 (Jul 15–Jul 22): Business sign-off or decision to extend pilot.

I've attached a first-pass MAP spreadsheet and the security Qs we discussed. Please review and tell me where you'd like us to tighten the timeline. If this looks right, can we confirm the procurement contact and the date Martha wants the final pricing?

Attachments: redwood-map-draft-20270622.xlsx, midline-security-questions.pdf

Thanks —
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0147

From: Bob Chen <bob.chen@midline.ai>

Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 11:02:45 -07:00
Subject: Re: Decision timetable & compliance mandates — next steps

Hannah —

Thanks for the crisp recap. A couple of clarifications from our side:

1) Econ owner — Martha confirmed she owns the budget and wants a line-item price for Dedicated vs. hosted API before July 8.
2) Security — our InfoSec team has begun filling out the questionnaire; two immediate asks: (a) an SSO SAML metadata sample and (b) a short note on how Redwood handles KV cache purging/retention for customer data.
3) Procurement — please send a procurement worksheet that lists typical lead time for dedicated capacity and any minimum commitment windows. Procurement email is procurement@midline.ai.

Also attaching a short internal note from our security lead about proof points they want (SOC2 cert, penetration test summary). We'll attach their note separately if useful.

On timing — Martha would like final pricing and a recommended POC scope by Friday, Jul 2 so she can include it in the July 6 finance packet. That accelerates the calendar a touch relative to your week-by-week outline — can you confirm whether the July 2 delivery is feasible?

Appreciate it,
Bob
Bob Chen
Head of Platform, Midline AI
[bob.chen@midline.ai]
